statement: Browser model against the Python model (numerical verification of the port) and browser model against stored Aspen Plus V15 results (python_vs_aspen-type comparison). Not validation; AmCraX has no experimental validation.

tolerances_vs_python.note: fixed before the comparison; a mismatch is a bug in the port, not a reason to widen a tolerance

browser_vs_python.process_off_grid_note: off-grid points: interpolated fields (pump, vaporiser, preheat, FEHE, cooler) carry bilinear-interpolation error of the Python grid; reported, not asserted

equilibrium_grid.note: browser ideal-gas equilibrium against Aspen RGibbs PENG-ROB; the difference is a model-form (non-ideality) difference

provenance.command: cd frontend; $env:AMCRAX_WRITE_PARITY='1'; npx vitest run src/sim/parity.test.ts
